summary: List Project Action Plan Template Items
description: Gets the list of Project Action Plan Template Items

parameters.name: filters[created_at]
parameters.description:
Return item(s) created within the specified ISO 8601 datetime range.
Formats:
`YYYY-MM-DD`...`YYYY-MM-DD` - Date
`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`...`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ` - DateTime with UTC Offset
`YYYY-MM-...

parameters.name: filters[id]
parameters.description: Return item(s) with the specified IDs.

parameters.name: filters[plan_template_id]
parameters.description: Return item(s) associated with the specified Action Plan Template ID.

parameters.name: filters[plan_template_section_id]
parameters.description: Return item(s) associated with the specified Action Plan Template Section ID(s).

parameters.name: filters[updated_at]
parameters.description:
Return item(s) last updated within the specified ISO 8601 datetime range.
Formats:
`YYYY-MM-DD`...`YYYY-MM-DD` - Date
`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`...`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ` - DateTime with UTC Offset
`YYY...

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Direction (asc/desc) can be controlled by the presence or absence of '-' before the sort parameter.

id.description: Unique identifier of the template item.

plan_template_item_assignees.description: Assignees responsible for this template item.

items.description: Project Action Plan Template Item Assignee (Compact)

created_at.description: Timestamp when the template item was created. ISO 8601 format.

due_at.description: Deadline for the template item. Null if no due date is set. ISO 8601 format.

description.description: Acceptance criteria or additional details describing what this item requires.

holding_type.description: Determines the scope of the hold point. 'plan' holds all succeeding items in the entire plan; 'section' holds only items in the same section.

plan_template_id.description: Unique identifier of the parent Action Plan Template.

position.description: Position of the template item within its section. Lower values appear first.

plan_template_section_id.description: Unique identifier of the section this item belongs to.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the template item was last modified. ISO 8601 format.
